text: Just came back after some persuasion. I must say, I enjoyed it a lot more than I remembered. The no cooking time for troops is a massive upgrade. I can just attack and practice to my hearts content. Not to mention all the reduced upgrade times in the lower town halls. It's been fun figuring things out again and playing with friends. This game is really goated for how long it's been going and still improving.

I've been playing Clash for the better part of 11 years now and I absolutely love the game. Everything from the mechanics to the aesthetic. I do have one major issue that seems to have been cropping up recently. 95% of the time my Electro Dragons turn away from the enemy's Town Hall, and right infront of it too, costing me stars and trophies. It was never an issue before the release of the Stage Battles were brought out for Builder Base. Please look into and fix this bug.

A game with good graphics, sound and visual but there is a problem with it. While running this game, it consumes too much battery and makes the devices hotter quickly. And this problem applies with every device, no matter how much costlier phone you are using. It's an humble request to supercell to look into this matter and fix it as soon as possible.

I played this game for a long time. Everything is great. I love the graphics, the wars, pretty much everything in the game. I have a suggestion. What if you lessen the time of upgrading heroes or the moment you upgrade it, it will eventually reach the next level because it consumes a lot of time. It takes days to upgrade and we tend to lose the opportunity to use it in clan wars or let's say, in crucial moments.

I really loved this game... It's not a game it's a emotion for me...I have 4 ID...but you know I have not the special obstacles and decorations Which was given many many days ago...So I really want it very much that it would be very good if they were given again atleast 1 piece...please I request for this... please...Then I don't have to look at other villages for the special obstacles.I don't have to do zoom in another village.

Definitely a great mobile game but the upgrade times are awful, only reason for not giving it 5 stars. I actually came back to change my 5 star rating, because the upgrade times are honestly too insanely long once you get to higher levels. It's discouraging and makes me not come back consistently anymore. I occasionally purchase those $1-$5 dollar deals the store offers, but I'm not willing to spend more real money just to progress faster.

I'm loving the game and actively playing it with multiple accounts. However, I sometimes find it challenging to keep track of upgrade and lab research progress across all my accounts. It's time-consuming and frustrating to switch between accounts frequently to check upgrade completion times and schedules. I'd appreciate it if you could address this issue.

I think and know this game is amazing, like who would come up with bomb wielding skeletons in an Air Balloon. you can battle online, single player, and you can build your own village however youd like, no interferences. You can also make your very own clan. It does have a few mishaps though, but very few, like the cost of the black elixir collector and how much space the wizards take up, but that's about it. This game is amazing overall and I hope you guys will enjoy it.

Probably one of the better freemium games as it at least gives you something to do other than waiting - building a base and attacking others with some amount of tactics. Apart from that, it's got a rather steep incline to where it is pretty much impossible to keep playing without pouring excessive amounts of money into it. Which is to be expected but of course sucks. The longer it keeps going, the more repetitive the little gameplay there is becomes and in the end there is nothing good here.

Bro I swear this game is such a time consuming game, which is the thing I like. I like how everything is balanced, kinda. The upgrades are fine even if it takes 15 days, I mean it's pretty reasonable, and there is alot of things I can do like trophie pushing, farming, make bases, start a clan, do clan wars and probably more. I have not come across any issues. Thank you supercell, I hope this game doesn't die.

Too good as this game provides too good experience and also good for connecting with people from all around the globe. The only thing that must be improved is 'practice mode' there must be more strategies and bases for attacking with our own skills. And also there must be a mode where we can design a base and attack on it by ourselves and also own base attacking. At the end of the day it is best android game.

Still a very nice game but there's one thing about it that I don't like which is where the troops you send attacks the farthest buildings even though they have one nearby. I tried a dragon attack but the dragons went full circle on the base than just punch through unlike I anticipated. Other concepts are good, it's just that one issue that's making me angry at this game momentarily. Edit: The troop a.i. still suck, like they take the most questonable directions.

The game is really fantastic and cool. I'm playing this game for years now, however there's one big issue that we can't text with our friends personally or privately and there's another issue that while we're attacking someone's Town Hall and the internet gets fluctuate or missed out and when the game opens back immediately it don't reload the attack.

Great game. Gameplay is smooth and intuitive. An astounding number of combos to try in all aspects of gameplay, from attacking to base building. It's something you can keep playing for years and never get bored. The addition of magic items was a great touch, and so was CWL and CG. But removing global was a disappointment. The global interraction, no matter how toxic people got, was a key feature of the game. Removing it made the game a lot more limited than the broad and fun platform it was.

This game is good. And also provides frequent updates. But the bad things are, in game updates are take a lot of time and the cost of updates are also higher than the cost of in game earings (gold and etc.) So that will be a good thing if Coc officials do something with it. Like, they can decrease the cost of updates or even they can increase the storage capacity and the earnings so we can at least update our town, Thank you.

I was off for 4 years but then i decided to download this game again just for the sake of memories but to my surprise the game has changed a lot( in a positive way). They have improvised and added a lot of content. During my time th10 used to be max but now it is not even close to max. I love how developers are still pushing regular updates and content into this game.

It's a fantastic game that I have ever played. I think it deserves 5 star. After many updates it is very interesting now. I satisfied with builder base mode, as there need no time to train troops besides without pay. So, I can enjoy the game every moment. I think friends if you really love strategic game then it will be a good option for you. Don't miss out this. I can realize what patience is. Besides enjoying, there are also learning of the time. Thank you!

I've been playing coc since 2015. I really liked it and had a lot of memories. I have one request to supercell. They updated everything else, but it's really inconvenient that I can't use it if I update hero level. Later, when we have a big army, it's really inconvenient if I don't have heroes. I've also spent a lot of time not war because of the hero level update. Please, can you fix this?

Well the game is perfectly good but just take into account some suggestions = 1. We need more builders since a list of construction needs to be done in villages. 2. Please fix the ping problem .sometimes due to fluctuation in internetour whole attack turns out to be a loss. 3. Sometimes the game freezes. I don't know why.

Best game for someone who wants to try different strategies, but a lot of patience is needed in this game(from the upgrading time of the buildings to the training time of troops).But i couldn't wait a lot, so I deleted the game and tried free fire.I recommend you also to try free fire. Once you download it, you will never think of deleting it.

Experience is very good, there's always new events, but the only problem for me is that it takes too long in upgrading, I always wait but now it feels boring, and also expensive when upgrading, this could have been a 5 star if so and no global texting which is more boring, and maybe you could give free skin or place in players in a specific event not just the boring money price or gems that you can take in cleaning your base. That's it, hope you take this into conclusion.

Best strategy game ever. All the new updates just make the game more fun to play. You dont even have to spend money to max out your base!! It doesnt take that much longer to progress without money. Even though the upgrades take longer, the cost gets more, so you still have something to do in that time you are waiting! Trophy pushing is also super fun

It's a world building game. I think it's an example for IKEA effect. We build our village from nothing and when time goes we slowly progress (now it's pretty fast in lower levels) and we build an emotional attachment to our base. Because of we invested so much time and effort in this game we'll always return even if we uninstall it. Because we are the cheif of the village and villagers are eagerly waiting for our arrival. That's something beautiful.......

It's an awesome app, I like it but there is one issue. When we get defeated we get a direct deduction of trophy what they showed us, But when we get 99% also we don't get even half if the trophies. Please fix that. Otherwise it is an awesome game. Keep it up. And also matchmaking in versus battle. I always get opponents who are much stronger and higher levels than me.

Very good game would recommend it. I can only think I can say 2 things that I'm not keen on about it the fist thing is that the time it takes to upgrade thing gets longer and longer the higher level it is and it just makes you very vonerable to attackers the other thing is I wish they made the season pass available to buy with gems it would really help.

I didn't even wanted to give a single star to this game, but for the sake of review, i was forced to lend a star. This game is awful. At the first, it was a quite nicer to play COC, but now it takes hell lot of time to upgrade the defenses and stuff. And the builders are so much expensive, I managed to buy only one extra builder,(I've 3 builders)but then lost the hope to buy more, as it will cost me 1500 Gems! And the matchmaking, its the worst of all.

I really love this game. I lost my account when I was younger and I just got it backand its still fun. My one problem is the upgrade time for buildings with higher level is too long. Even with five builders it's a hassle having to wait days for one building to upgrade to later upgrade another building which would also take days. Even with builders potions it still takes too long to upgrade. If you can reduce the upgrade time it would be great but besides that it's amazing

As a dedicated gamer, I can say that Clash of Clans is a must-play for strategy enthusiasts. The game's blend of base-building, clan warfare, and real-time battles keeps you hooked. While in-app purchases can be a bit of a downer for competitive players, the sense of community and strategic depth more than make up for it. It's a classic in the mobile gaming world.

Uh, I've been playing this game for over 4 years and I've faced no issues. I haven't paid a single buck and reached legends league with townhall 12 recently, also have all the collectibles and almost 10,000 gems (excludes 4 hero skins and 5 builder huts). For those who think clash of clans is a pay to win game, this proves that you can play the game without paying, all you need is patience. Paying is just used to speed up your progress.

The trophies earned in multiplayer battles are unfair. For example, if you win 3 stars, you get 22 trophies and if you lose, you will be deducted 7. However, if you win but only 99% (due to time), you can only get 7 trophies which in my opinion, doesn't compensate for the skills you did to play the game, aiming for the win. I think it's only fair if you receive atleast 18-20 trophies for reaching almost 3 stars.

After a few years of playing this game, a "chore" that needs to be taken care of is what I'd call it. It grows out of being fun, and becomes a habit, and soon, ends up becoming a chore with the fun mostly gone. Now that I know the new town hall updates aren't gonna stop anytime soon, I feel very less incentive to take care of the chore anymore... With new updates that seem to roll out every week, while changing the very core gameplay elements, I wont keep this up. It's aged badly is what I'd say

Only mobile game I've ever played and I've played it for a long time. New update is great but unfortunately full of bugs which don't seem to be getting fixed. The game disconnects while half way through a battle and when it reconnected you've lost the battle plus any money spent. It was never like this before the latest update to town hall 14 hope they sort it out soon as I wont be spending a penny more on it till they do.

A good game despite it's age. As far as I remember I was in 2nd Grade on elementary when this was released. I'm an adult now and I'm glad to I've tried this game now. Hearing Giant Peka about my classmate back then, and like finally I'll be able to play the game they've played! The game is fun! Build, build, attack, attack, layouts, saving gems, and learning new things is very fun. The kind of fun where your just starting, learning how things work on the game and building your level up. Big 👍

I REALLY love the idea of the 2.0 Builder Hall, However, It has been poorly executed. The troops are too few and too weak to put up with the new BH, and I know that's done in order to make it easier to attack but it's nearly impossible to get more than 2/6 stars. The bases usually have the most possible defenses on the first base and fewer on the second, making it impossible for BH 6-8 to get 2+ stars. I believe that having more troop space in the army camps would fix this issue. Thank you.

Heroes can still be tweaked. Generally it is an okay system, not too fancy, not too complicated, the only way to improve your heroes is to follow the linear upgrade path. Obviously there are pets, but those can only be unlocked when you reach the endgame. Upgrading a hero takes lots of time and while this is all happening, they cannot be used in battle. Since heroes are essential, this can make attacking like a chore without them, making it pointless to attack while your hero are being upgraded.

since playing this game since 2013 I'm very disappointed I have invested so much time into it for an upgrade to come for reduced cost of defences when I built mine at a higher price. This goes for walls as well. New players get it easier then someone like me who has played for a longer period of time. Should we not get a refund for the difference in costs we spent which was higher??? Not impressed

It's a pretty good game and I've been playing it for so long. There was never anything wrong with the game except for longer upgrade time at higher town Hall's which is to be expected. But recently, whenever play the game, sometimes, while attacking opponents, the zoom in and zoom out gestures gets reversed and am not able to deploy the troops.

There's nothing to complain for this game. It's one of the best android games ever.Just 1 problem is that it's trophy system sucks, it's very hard to rank up in th 10 onwards. Best thing is that its ad free! Which is nowadays very rare. Gems are also very easy to earn. Now it has improved alot, before it was a bit tough to earn resources but now it's a lot easier. I have no issues with UI, graphics and any other aspects. Keep it up Supercell.

An outstanding game worth downloading. Every detail is thought out and there are still regular updates which is incredible. The game provides a constant stream of fresh events and updates while generally providing a smooth gaming experience. Game progression does notably slow down as you advance through the town halls but I think that's a good thing. My town hall is now level 12 and for me that just shows years of dedicated playing. 5 stars! I Recommend. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

It used to be good but now it's not. Even if I win a battle and end battle it is deducting trophies. And also that it takes a minimum of half an hour to search for an opponent. If I win a battle I get a minimum of 6 or 7 trophies, but I lose 40 trophies on defense. EDIT: now even after I finish my attack, the low internet symbol is coming and I am losing trophies. What the HELL!

Like in Sim City we can't rotate the base to see other sides of the buildings, we're only able to zoom in and out in the same screen. The game will be in next level if we are able to see the base as real time building in all the directions and it will we amazing to see troops deployment and attacks in multi-dimension.

One of the best strategy games. You may find it boring at start at it takes big time to upgrade a building, a troop or to train an army. At the start of this game there wasn't so events as it was a new game but now they have added a lot of events such as cwl or clan games and there are boosters also which help things do faster.You can make different base layouts or can train different armies.But the thing is you have play it frequently.This was a only bad point.Now its up to you to play or Not

Rank pushing is no longer a thing in this game. Every time I'm looking for a base to attack, they're finding me bases that are AT LEAST 2 TH LEVELS HIGHER than mine for minimal amount of trophies. There are definitely same th level players in the game with similar amount of trophies that I have, still they always land on unfair bases. Very annoying. This was the reason I quit the game last time after playing for straight 6-7 years and this might be the reason I'd quit and uninstall it again.

I've been playing it for far too long. But there is one thing that gets me mad and I will go on extended breaks because of it. Sometimes when clashing and the connection resets or switches, it doesn't allow you to rejoin a battle in progress. Instead it just kills the battle and you end up with half used troops and a lost game (or not as good of a score). This needs to be fixed guys at this point.

Quite a few years ago I played alot but had "quit". I remember during those years it was fun and all but it got tougher in terms of gameplay to get in-game currency. So I stopped playing. However I've been playing for about 2 weeks now and the game has change significantly for the better. It is so much interactive and so many ingame events making it so much easier to earn elixir, gold, etc. Since I'm TH9 ive been able to upgrade 7-8 buildings every few days. Ty Supercell Keep this going!

A time consuming, mental straining and never ending game. The developers of this game should decrease the time and cost of upgrading buildings, heroes and troops to make the game easy and enjoyable. The effort taken in upgrading is not worth your valuable time. I have seen school and college kids spending long hours each day to play this game and finally end up in doing nothing in their careers. Conclusion - Your valuable time is not worth spending on this game.

Clash of Clans is really fun and addictive! It's a good mix of strategy, hanging out with friends, and making your village stronger. You can spend money to get ahead, but it's totally playable without paying. You just need patience and time. It's even more fun when you join a clan with friends. Sometimes it gets frustrating because upgrades take a long time and are hard to do. But it's still worth playing!

I went back to this game after three years, and I'm surprised to see the great improvement. Back then, I quit the game because I was pissed off from having to start from scratch after being unable to link my old account to my new device. Now, there's even a supercell ID already, which is very commendable. I can enjoy this game once more without having to worry about losing my data.

"Clash of Clans is an epic game! Love building and customizing my village, and battling with other clans to dominate! The game requires strategy and planning to upgrade troops and defenses! Need to join a strong clan to participate in wars and earn rewards! The graphics are impressive, and the characters are so cool! Best multiplayer game I've played, love the competition and camaraderie!"

This game is by far one of the best strategy mobile games ever created. It has all the element and features that are both entertaining, fun, and can be somewhat addictive. Graphics are great, the characters are unique and cool(troops), and plenty of rewards which makes the game even more awesome. Overall, its a good game and well developed.Well done!

It has its ups and downs. Its pretty boring for the most part but it's not hard to get things done. A lot of cosmetics are paid to get not many free ones. I really dislike the builder base aspect of the game. I find it very unfair in how it matches players which can end up very frustrating. I'm not a fan of a lot of costumes for the heroes. It just doesn't feel worth wasting $ on. It's a good game to pass the time but lots of rude players and since there's no chat its hard to find a clan you fit

This is one of the best games I have ever played, its getting better in every update, only one thing that is missing in this game is 'many people like me play this game in many accounts and we get lots of resources like gems, coins, elixir and dark elixir in a account which we play with least priority so it would be good if we could transfer the resources from one account to another just like we donate troops'. This is the thing I found is missing in this game, please include this feature soon.

This is a perfect game if you got the patience and don't want to spend a lot of active time in it. Just log in, collect resources, do a couple of upgrades and battles and you are set. This doesn't mean that the game doesn't offer enough challenge and deepness. Between the multiple ways you can play and the constant updates, there are tons of hours of gameplay here. On the negative side, the upgrades get really long after the first few levels and there's lot pay content. Overall a great game.

Addictive. Very addictive. This game is actually quite nice to play after certain intervals, but the wait times later on in the game are painfully long, requiring you to pay gems if you wish to progress any faster than a snail. Despite this, there are many aspects of this game which make me keep coming back to it for - I am a big fan of the Builder Base, since it lets you attack other bases and try new tactics without any punishment for 0 star attacks. Overall, great game, even if playing F2P.

The game overall is addictive and fun yet the matchmaking for multilayer battles is not balanced. Anyone that you try to attack will be above you and almost impossible to even get 1 star but everyone below you will give you about 2 trophies. And by the time you find one that is not too hard to attack and gives you decent trophies and resources, you've already spent about 20 minutes searching. When someone attacks you they take 35 trophies each time making it extremely hard to go up in trophies.

brilliant but wish we could have night mode it would look great in battle. I still love playing this game yes I did have a problem with the game freezing or going super slow but yes I do still love playing all is good at the moment so happy days. P. S. Could you please reduce the time it takes to regenerate the heroes then we would be able to do more attacks. Thank you. March 23rd 2021. Please help me I can't get onto clash why won't it let me play it won't even load. Thanks for no help. Sorted.

Gaming experience is awesome. Well and good! But though a big problem which I am facing is when I uninstall and reinstall the app, it doesn't store my account (already logged in) details. Yeah my village is saved but not my account. Instead it asks me log and in again which is time consuming. So it would be great if SUPERCELL team makes the game(device) permanently store our account details though we uninstall!!!

Game is fun but I keep experiencing my chance in fighting in the war keeps getting taken whenever I get cut during the actual battle when it isn't finished and the star/s that I gained weren't recorded, I mean if you're not going to at least record whatever I gained before I got kicked out from the game then please give me the chance to fight it again. It's frustrating when you saw that you gained 2 stars and not see it recorded and see that you have no chance to even try to get it back.

Always find myself coming back to this game when I'm bored. Updated the game a day ago and now I couldn't play at all. Been stuck in the loading screen. My wifi works with other apps but it keeps kicking me out in the loading screen saying connection lost. The loading bar is always stuck at 5% and sometimes it says downloading content but after 2 minutes it kicks me out???

Great game. Very addictive. Maintenance breaks should occur in the middle of the night.. seems to keep happening before I attack. I can't find a English chat.. iv tried changing language but I keep getting into chat rooms with no one who speaks my language.. everything else is amazing.. keep up the good work.. .. .. ok 2nd time with the maintenance break right at the beginning of war and will continue to rate less stars until maintenance break occurs in the middle of the night.

I absolutely love this game! The graphics, the concept, the original ideas and everything, yeah. I love it. Only problem- make it possible to change name by paying for it or every 30 days. That would really help with my cringey name that prevents me from returning to the game, although I got really far.

Im gonna be honest, lots of these _____ building games miss something, something to do when you're waiting for things to build. Even watching money flow in constantly gives you something; take this from games like cookie clicker and ad cap. Even a game i used to play about building a resturant, i could sit there and collect tips from customers. This game is great and i've spent lots of time on it, but it's missing that one little thing to keep me constantly invested.

Clash of Clans is a fun and engaging game with lots of strategic depth. Building and upgrading your base, planning attacks, and working with your clan adds a lot of variety and excitement. The game is well-supported with frequent updates, offering new challenges and features. Though it can take time to progress, the sense of achievement when you improve your base or win a war makes it all worth it. Overall, it’s a solid game for anyone who enjoys strategy and teamwork.

It's a good fun game but the waiting times of things like 16 hours to upgrade a defence is rediculous. Like, it's what would put people off the game. Why make it so long...? I get you want us to spend money on your game but it's rediculous and not worth it. Like I enjoy every other aspect of this game apart from having to wait anywhere up to 3 days for things to upgrade. Not fun.

I was totally hooked on that game for ages. Building my village, planning attacks, and crushing other players was so satisfying. The graphics are awesome, and the strategic depth kept me coming back. I loved the clan wars – super intense! The only downside? sometimes those in-app purchases feel a bit pushy. But overall, it's a blast!

Clash of Clans is an absolutely legendary game! The strategy, base building, and clan wars keep it exciting even after years of playing. Regular updates, new troops, heroes, and events always bring something fresh. Playing with friends and clanmates makes it even more fun. The balance between strategy and action is perfect, and the graphics and sound are top-notch. Easily one of the best mobile games ever made. Highly recommended!

In psychology and in cognitive neuroscience, patience is studied as a decision making problem, involving the choice of either a small reward in the short-term, versus a more valuable reward in the long term. It's like a great game .I think it's good for freshness of mind. I don't think anyone noticed that you need patience to reach its highest level ... and you don't know that it's like a game where you get everything after a while without any quick ⏩ money-like movement. Discover Yourself.

In Clash of Clans, one of the most exciting and rewarding aspects of the game is being part of a Clan. Clans bring players together, creating a strong sense of teamwork, strategy, and friendship. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, joining a Clan adds an entirely new dimension to the game. It’s where players can truly grow, improve, and enjoy the game to the fullest. One of the best parts of being in a Clan is the teamwork it encourages. Players work together toward common goals,

I played the game around a decade ago and returning to it now. The new modes builder base, clan capital, clan games are amazing. Unpopular opinion, I enjoy them more compared to home village. My only complaint with the game is that it's match making is still a mess. People like to play at lower trophies because it is rewarding for loot and its discouraging to have higher trophies as you are paired with higher strength bases while your heroes are always on upgrade.

I am playing this game on and off from the time when townhall lvl 11 was highest. Have poured so much love and time into this. The game gets intetesting and easier over time . Making training free was the best move ever. I still miss the Global Chat. Used to be my favourite feature but, I know why it had to go. Game is best played if you are in an active clan. Loads of events and and lots of things to do. Switching between two more more supercell accounts is also flawless. Thanks !!!

I Know the review is late, but I Must say that Unlike Any Game i have seen, this is one of those Games that I could not forget, it literally tests the patience on as everyone knows everything, so many possibilities in an Attack, and you don't know until the end that is it a Certain Victory or Not, anything might happen... But i would ask for one thing, If it is possible to bring the 3rd Person Visual, In which you can click on the Troop you want to, and then control them. I couldn't Write More..

I started playing Clash of clans about 4 years ago. At that time it was the best mobile game you could possibly get on play store. But slowly supercell started making mistakes. The first one that I can speak of is adding the builder base. The biggest problem is the interconnect between the two bases. I absolutely hated the builder base but had to play because it inhibited so many main village upgrades.

The servers suddenly get busy all of sudden. This has happened so many times while attacking... I've lost so many games because of it. It's so annoying.. I'm requesting Supercell team to please fix this issue ASAP. 🙏🏼 Also the town hall 13 onwards all the buildings look so bad like plasticky.. please bring the traditional look back🙏🏼.. Upto Town Hall 11 is really good..

Kinda ruthless game for a FTP player. The upgrade time and cost are exorbitant and it absolutely ridicules me to my core. You'll have to spend your whole lifetime upgrading things in this game. Basically, they'll make you spend much more valuable thing if you're not spending dollars in this game. Even if you're not ftp player you still have to empty your pockets quite a bit to go through different levels smoothly. No values, only greed is behind this game.

The best game ever created by supercell. I never get bored, doesn't matter how much I play. With the whole new town hall 16 update the game feels fresh and new. Upgrading the hero equipment is fun and challenging. Also, the deduction in upgrade times has made upgrading easier and more fun. Definitely a must play game.

One of my most favourite games. Very intriguing and the graphics and sounds are beautiful. You can build your own little village with is really great, along with that you can also do stuff like attacking other player's bases for loot to help in upgrading your own base, there are also fun clan wars and clan games which are like little quests. Only downside may be the ridiculous time it may take to finish upgrades of both buildings as well as troops of your base. Fun for long-term gaming.

They are too greedy. PC games take more time and effort to build the game but there is not option for the PC AAA games to complete with in-game purchases, but you can complete this game in a day with money. I can let this slide but the wost thing is buying and selling in-game items. Buying any items costs 50 times more than selling the same item for eg ruins cost 1500 gems to buy and if you sell you will only get 50 gems. Never seen any game this greedy for money.
This is very amazing and unbeliever game. Everyone try this game and enjoy with Clash of Clans.
an amazing gaming app I love this app This helps in happiness when I fell light The only one thing what to do join in E-stport of COC any one helps me in that
this games cache files are unclearable and this game has some network issues.
Awesome and addictive fair game play and new events and updates all time 10 years still playing.
I love the game right now, because no need to cook youre troops in a long time.
Good game, but now the rank game is limited and due to it i cannot push my rank
Oh man, do updates really come this often? An update seems to arrive every two or three days—I'm getting really fed up!
This is the best game i have ever see in my life . This game gives a life lesson that good things takes time. This is all about patience.
UI in the battlepass is messed up for longer phones, hope it gets fixed.
its fun its hard i like it i wish that there would be secret heros or rewarded heros based on the month and holiday(limeted time)
really awesome game ✨😌 i really like it you can play with your friends also..
we need a 3x fast forward button for matches after 1st minute passes also need to have like half the walls b able to go n2 the air to stop dragons once walls r destroyed the air net breaks
